title: Bevel records
description: A full-width pale card with a teal wash: a phone on the left running off the bottom edge, a big three-line title and grey paragraph on the right, and between them small white icon tiles sitting on two faint concentric rings. The rings turn from -6° to 6° and two small floating cards drift up as the card scrolls through the window. On phones the text sits on top and the rings arc over the phone.
notes: phone and floating cards are media slots; the tiles hold lucide icons
the turn and drift are CSS scroll-driven animations; off under reduced motion
